ThingDef.label: mammoth meat
ThingDef.description: マンモスの肉。並の家畜肉より脂が乗っており、量も多い。\n\nMeat from a mammoth. Richer and more plentiful than ordinary livestock meat.

ThingDef.label: Japanese wolf meat
ThingDef.description: ニホンオオカミの肉。野生の獣肉らしい引き締まった味わい。\n\nMeat from a Japanese wolf. Lean and gamey, as expected of a wild predator.

ThingDef.label: adamantite flesh
ThingDef.description: アダマンタイトの肉。金属質の獣でありながら食用可能な肉を持つ、不思議な生物の残滓。ほのかに金属じみた味がする。\n\nFlesh from an adamantite beast. Strange remains of a metallic creature that nonetheless yields edible meat, with a faint metallic tang.
